title: Neural typing character reconstruction
scientific_question: Can MEG/EEG recover typed characters on held-out people/sessions without relying on a language rescorer?
primary_outputs: Character sequence per sentence using neural-only outputs; optional fixed-LM sequence separately.

data_manifest.size_category: 100GB–1TB per dataset card; no measured full-storage total

recording_contract.labels: MAT logs with key/RSVP events,Time,Keycode,Pressed,stim,trial_id; derived Keystroke,Word,Sentence events
recording_contract.time_alignment: Loader aligns recording triggers to behavioral logs, including dynamic time warping of ambiguous MEG inter-event intervals; exclusions and missing matches must be recorded.
recording_contract.biological_ids: Explicit warning: different MEG subject numbers can be same person; official correction logic/spreadsheet needed before splitting. EEG test fixture20subjects is not proof of final included cohort.
recording_contract.evidence: Parent-fetched HF API metadata/tree inspected locally; pinned loader text independently inspected; license fetched directly

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

case_definition: One isolated biological-unit/session packet under the split policy; multiple scored observations are nested items, not independent biological cases.

split.policy: Resolve participant aliases first; then group person, sentence template and complete sessions; equal target-person calibration and no query transcripts.
split.uncertainty: Biological-unit paired uncertainty where multiple units exist; single-animal/person tasks use descriptive session/trial blocks and do not imply population replication.

reference.role: Official V1 neural typing-decoder source, loader and metrics; no execution or full final-language-model result claim.

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

evaluation.comparability: Task variants and related outcomes share source/family evidence. Never sum task counts as independent cohorts or average unlike native metrics.
